title: Turumsa language
description: Papuan language of Papua New Guinea
extract: Turumsa is a possibly extinct Papuan language of Makapa village in Gogodala Rural LLG, Middle Fly District, Papua New Guinea. It has been classified as a Bosavi language, and is 19% lexically similar with Dibiyaso, but this appears to be due to loans. It has a greater (61%) lexical similarity with Doso, its only clear relative.
